scale_policy.description: Place with isotropic scale s = scale_m / size_xyz[scale_axis]. Rigid: scale_axis is argmax(size_xyz), scale_m is the matching est length/width/height. Human: scale_axis=z, scale_m=est_height_m.

heading_policy.description: Rigid canonical.heading is the asset-local front axis after canonicalization (typically +X for vehicles/signs). Omitted when undefined. Humans use person.yaw_deg_start instead.
